stemMarkdown: In what ratio must a solution containing 35% acid be mixed with a solution containing 88% acid to obtain a mixture that is 65% acid? Give the ratio (cheaper : dearer) in simplest form, e.g. '3:2'.
solutionMarkdown: By alligation: $\dfrac{\text{cheaper}}{\text{dearer}} = \dfrac{y - z}{z - x} = \dfrac{88 - 65}{65 - 35} = \dfrac{23}{30} = 23:30$ (after simplifying by dividing both terms by 1).
